newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Verilink started as hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Verilink started as hold.

text.p: Salomon Brothers on Tuesday said it started coverage of Verilink Corp with a hold rating.
-- Analyst Stephen Levy said in a research note that he expects the company's 1997 revenues to decline by four percent from 1996, and sees the year's earnings at $0.50 a share.
-- He saw fiscal year 1998, which ends in June, at $0.20 a share.
-- Levy said that the company's recent earnings shortfalls were a function of Verilink's relationship with Nortel, which continues to be weak.
-- Levy said he believes the company has the right product portfolio and the right strategy to suceed in the integrated access system market over the long-term.
